effect: The blood vessels completed the nervous tissue and the last goal. The result also distinguishes signals carried by nerves from materials carried by blood.
reaction: That distinction was clear, though the supporting cells and fatty coverings appeared without much explanation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the receiving cells to the prepared fibres was most worthwhile: the picture traced a signal along a cell and chemical messengers across the gap to another cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the blood vessels was straightforward but less interesting as a decision; the goal and picture already made the pairing clear.

surprise.text: The finished tissue included small supporting cells and fatty fibre coverings that we hadn't assembled separately. Their roles weren't explained here.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless. The pieces and goals made each pairing understandable, although the added coverings were unexplained.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter because seeing how the parts connect to carry messages was useful, though the choices here were fairly predictable.
